name: research
title: Research / Investigation
description: INVESTIGATION. Deep parallel exploration, no implementation. Returns findings.

resolutions.rationale: Parallel exploration slots each summarize the codebase from their own angle; every slot's full summary stays available in its slot-scoped artifact (<id>-<slot>.json). The shared artifact deterministically resolves the required 'summary' scalar to the first roster slot's contribution so downstream stages receive a stable synthesis. Every applied disagreement is recorded in the synthesis provenance (conflicts) with the winning slot and losing values — never discarded silently.
